description: Source code implementing MULTI/EXEC transaction management, WATCH key monitoring, and related client state handling in Redis.

classes.name: watchedKey
classes.description: Structure representing a key being watched by a client, including key object, database, client reference, and expiration flag.

methods.name: initClientMultiState
methods.description: Initializes the client's MULTI/EXEC state, resetting command list and counters.

methods.name: freeClientMultiState
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the client's MULTI/EXEC state, freeing command list and arguments.

methods.name: queueMultiCommand
methods.description: Adds a new command to the client's transaction queue, reallocating memory as needed.

methods.name: discardTransaction
methods.description: Clears the client's current transaction, resetting state and unwatching keys.

methods.name: flagTransaction
methods.description: Marks the client's transaction as dirty if in MULTI mode, indicating an error occurred.

methods.name: multiCommand
methods.description: Starts a new transaction if not already in one, sending OK reply.

methods.name: discardCommand
methods.description: Aborts the current transaction if in one, sending OK reply.

methods.name: execCommandAbort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction with a specific error message and notifies monitors.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes all queued commands in a transaction, handling ACL checks, permissions, and cleanup.

methods.name: watchCommand
methods.description: Sets watch on specified keys for the client, preventing nested WATCH in MULTI.

methods.name: unwatchCommand
methods.description: Removes all watched keys for the client and clears dirty flag.

methods.name: multiStateMemOverhead
methods.description: Calculates memory overhead of client's MULTI/EXEC state and watched keys.
